incumbent.text: Skip cache insertion when the resolved subproblem response carries a cycle marker, then compare cache-enabled and cache-disabled results on a cyclic traversal and verify that ordinary acyclic subproblems still hit.

hint: A cached recursive permission resolver is outermost in the resolver chain, so a cache hit returns before the inner visited-path cycle guard runs. The cache key covers tuple identity, store, model, contextual tuples and request context but not the visited-path set. The immediate uncertainty is whether a response whose metadata reports a detected cycle is inserted and replayed at all; a counting delegate and two identical subproblem calls can answer that without a full server.
